messages.content: Judge one candidate continuity attachment. Return JSON only. NOT_ATTACHED = the Subject merely holds, carries, touches, supports, or is near the object, or the object is attached to something else. UNSPECIFIED = the text does not establish whether it is attached. Judge only the supplied final-frame text.

SUBJECT: Lena
CANDIDATE ATTACHED OBJECT: paint
FINAL-FRAME TEXT: Wet blue paint coats Lena's hands.

Return {"status":"ATTACHED|NOT_ATTACHED|UNSPECIFIED"}.
